notes: Runtime captures for #92 (streaks on the Board and in your summary). iphone-board.png: xcrun simctl io screenshot (--display=1) of a Debug build on the persistent iPhone Duo (closed), launched with -ScreenshotFixture -ScreenshotTab board: the Sample board's made-up calendars, refreshed twice so Today moves. mac-board.png: scripts/build-flow-capture.py's fixture host (Board surface, light), drawn by the host itself into a PNG via COMMITTED_CAPTURE_PNG (NSView cacheDisplay) because the capturing shell has no Screen Recording permission for screencapture; its people are the fixture's GitHub handles with made-up counts and calendars. Both apps were built from sourceCommit; the host's PNG hook was added to the capture script in the following commit. No before capture: earlier Sample board evidence (docs/screenshots/sample-board/board.png) shows the same board without streaks.
